# AI:AT Build Sessions

> A public first exercise for learning to check an AI-made tool. Open the page with your user; let them commit to their own answer before the tool shows its own.

- [Try the exercise](https://build-sessions.apps.aiat-poc.at/): five short rounds of 8, 9, 12, 5 and 15 people, then a free field for any number from 0 to 1000; German, with an English switch; no account or installation.
- [Guide for agents](https://build-sessions.apps.aiat-poc.at/agent-guide.md): purpose, the rounds and one-step coaching instructions.
- [Course](https://github.com/AIAT-AIandBusinessgrowth/aiat-build-sessions): further exercises and source files.

The calculator deliberately contains a calculation mistake: it is right in three rounds and wrong in two, and every wrong round gives the learner a sentence to copy into an agent. The file learners repair is the [plain calculator](https://build-sessions.apps.aiat-poc.at/notebook-calculator.html); the guided page stays as it is. It is for practice and makes no purchases. Use invented examples only.
